request.summary: 本次评审覆盖 TASK-005 S2 的本地清理、冷重开、重新同步、旧 Diagnostic 残留检查、历史展示和 ACK。目标会话按 App 现有 per-task Clear 被清空后重新出现；目标缓存中没有 Diagnostic item 或 Diagnostic discriminator，UI 有历史文本且没有可见 Diagnostic，服务端 ACK 均 ok=true。覆盖保持 partial，且没有把稳定结构化事件字段和值逐项对应到 App 可见内容，因此不把 S2 或完整历史标记为通过。

executed_subject.head: 29a199d2eb3faa8838185d1577c40f0ec4779e00
executed_subject.scope: Task005 S2 App per-conversation cache clear, cold reopen, product history resync, Diagnostic residual, UI and ACK evidence

source_revision.state: read-only review; no product source, service configuration, remote data or device cache mutation

findings.title: 同步覆盖仍为 partial，不能宣称完整历史
findings.body: 重开后目标会话有 98 个 item、7 个 committed history segment，provider_mode=product_db，complete=false、coverage_state=partial、coverage_complete=false；最新 server.codex.history.ack_received 均 ok=true 但 state=partial。清理、首屏展示和 ACK 证据成立，完整历史覆盖仍未验证。
requirements: Task005 S2 保持 bounded/partial coverage 真实

findings.title: 本次重开证据未把具体结构化字段值对应到 App 可见事件
findings.body: 数据库 item type 与递归 discriminator 检查均未发现 Diagnostic，UI XML 显示历史文本且没有可见 Diagnostic；但本次执行只记录 visible_history_message_text_count=1，没有稳定 item_key、字段路径和值与该可见事件的逐项关联。因此本次操作验证了历史可见性和 Diagnostic 缺失，仍不能单独满足 S2 的具体结构化事件字段可见性要求。
requirements: Task005 S2 acceptance: concrete structured event field visible

prior_findings_assessment.assessment: 本次是既有 App 清理与重同步验证，没有修改 Node 投影或产品代码；本次目标缓存无 Diagnostic 不能替代对 Node 全局投影边界的独立评定。
本次可见历史与无 Diagnostic 证据得到补强，但仍没有稳定结构化字段值与 App 可见事件的逐项关联。

checks.name: target selection and clear scope
checks.detail: App Codex Storage Management exact target row; local history/media-only confirmation; target rows became zero while endpoint count changed 133 to 132.

checks.name: other sessions and configuration
checks.detail: Other 132 endpoint rows remained; count returned to 133 after target resync; service configuration and remote history were not changed.

checks.name: reopen and history display
checks.detail: Cold force-stop/launcher reopen; target row and Codex connected surface returned; target cache repopulated with 98 items and 7 segments; one visible history message.

checks.name: Diagnostic residual
checks.detail: Target cache item type count and recursive discriminator payload count were both zero; visible Diagnostic text count was zero.

checks.name: ACK
checks.detail: 80 matching server.codex.history.ack_received records; latest six were ok=true, purpose=history_sync, state=partial.

checks.name: source and mutation boundary
checks.detail: No product source edit, build/test, server configuration edit, remote database command, or manual cache/database deletion.

adb am force-stop com.termlink.app and launcher monkey cold reopen

excluded: Other sessions, service configuration, remote data, product source and IPC/Rust/Node architecture remained outside scope

provenance.observation_sources: Recorded execution, read-only Android cache aggregates, UI XML, local server health and diagnostic ACK logs

limits: The execution and review are caller-reported/self-reviewed rather than independent review.
The target history remains partial; item and segment counts do not establish complete historical coverage.
A generic visible history message does not establish a stable structured event field/value mapping in the App.
Existing unassociated management records remain unresolved and are not repaired by this review.
remaining_work: Keep S2 in progress; do not finish or close it from this review.
If S2 acceptance is required, record a concrete stable item/field/value to App-visible correlation and preserve partial coverage truth.
Retain prior Node projection-boundary finding TASK005-S2-R2 until its separately scoped evidence or repair is reviewed.
S3 details/history and S4 extended real-device validation remain not started.

recommendation.reason: The exact execution is acceptable with limits, but the current step remains in progress with open findings; use execute-step only if the user authorizes repair or a finish disposition.
